forum.title: Does STM32G0B1KBU6 Support PD 3.1
forum.best_answer_content:
*> Is there any way to connect STM32G0B1KBU6  to USB-C to comply PD 3.1 requirements?*

No, you need the CC2 pin to be exposed. Consider using a larger chip or the "N" version of the LQFP32.

![Screenshot 2026-03-16 175315.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/1f70a72f-99bd-4aa3-0923-90675b0d11ce.png "Screenshot 2026-03-16 175315.png")
forum.content_text: According to the PD 3.1 requirements (also PD 3.0), I need to connect UCPD1\_CC1 and UCPD1\_CC2 to USB-C CC1 and CC2 to communicate and request the desired voltage. But STM32G0B1KBU6  has only UCPD1\_CC1 available. Is there any way to connect STM32G0B1KBU6  to USB-C to comply PD 3.1 requirements?
forum.author: HDKLog
